patterns.description: A significant number of customers report dissatisfaction with the quality, taste, or preparation of the food.
Customers frequently report issues with the staff's demeanor, politeness, or attentiveness.
Several reviews mention negative aspects of the restaurant's atmosphere or environment.
Customers report various unspecified negative experiences or general dissatisfaction not covered by other categories.
A recurring concern among customers is that the prices are too high or do not offer good value for money.
Some customers express concerns regarding the cleanliness of the restaurant.
A small but recurring number of reviews indicate dissatisfaction with the waiting period for service or food.

root_causes.pattern: A significant number of customers report dissatisfaction with the quality, taste, or preparation of the food.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent food preparation, use of lower quality ingredients, or issues with recipe execution.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently report issues with the staff's demeanor, politeness, or attentiveness.
root_causes.cause: Insufficient staff training in customer service, understaffing leading to stress, or lack of management oversight.

root_causes.pattern: Several reviews mention negative aspects of the restaurant's atmosphere or environment.
root_causes.cause: Outdated decor, poor lighting, uncomfortable seating, or excessive noise levels.

root_causes.pattern: Customers report various unspecified negative experiences or general dissatisfaction not covered by other categories.
root_causes.cause: Broad operational inefficiencies, lack of attention to detail, or specific unaddressed customer needs.

root_causes.pattern: A recurring concern among customers is that the prices are too high or do not offer good value for money.
root_causes.cause: Menu prices not aligning with perceived value, portion sizes, or quality of food/service.

root_causes.pattern: Some customers express concerns regarding the cleanliness of the restaurant.
root_causes.cause: Inadequate cleaning protocols, insufficient staff for cleaning, or lack of regular maintenance.

root_causes.pattern: A small but recurring number of reviews indicate dissatisfaction with the waiting period for service or food.
root_causes.cause: Inefficient kitchen operations, understaffing during peak hours, or poor table management.
